Trivia:
- "Heartwork" music video later appeared in an episode of Beavis and Butt-Head called Skin Trade.
- Front album sculpture "Life Support" copyright H.R. Giger 1993, used by kind permission.
- "Arbeit macht Fleisch" would likely best be translated into "work will make you into meat" (cf. Arbeit macht frei).

Recording information:

Recorded and mixed at Parr Street Studios between May 18th - June 21st, 1993.
